name: 강림 · 저승길 차림
quote: 명부에 적힌 운명은 피할 수 없다.
outfit: 선명한 청록색과 흰색이 조화된 단령 스타일의 관복
gloves: 금색 테두리가 있는 흰색 손목 보호대
silhouette: 휘둘러지는 긴 사슬의 궤적, 등 뒤에 떠 있는 명부 두루마리, 짧고 단단한 체형
signature_motion: 사슬을 크게 휘둘러 적을 포박하는 동작
signature_vfx: 금빛 사슬이 지나간 자리에 남는 청록색 잔상과 신성한 입자
unique_features: 등 뒤에 떠 있는 명부 두루마리
visual_en: A small 2-head tall boy with bright skin and short deep blue hair, wearing a vibrant cyan and white traditional Korean official robe. Small jade-colored magical orbs drift around his body. He holds a thick, glowing golden chain that extends outwards, creating a dynamic arc. A white scroll with golden patterns, the Underworld Register, floats behind his back. His eyes shine with intense golden light, and his wrists are adorned with white guards trimmed in gold.
features_en: Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing firmly facing right, ready to lash out the chain.
vfx_en: Golden chain trails with cyan magical sparks and divine particles.
lore: 저승 차사 소년 — 저승길 업데이트의 얼굴. 쇠사슬을 휘둘러 적을 묶는다. 무기 쇠사슬 · 명부.
concept: 이 게임 세계(요괴 · 이면 — 한국 설화) 영웅. 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

parent_body.body: A small, humanoid character with blue hair, wearing a blue and white robe, standing upright.

derive.prompt: Keep this exact same character: the same face, head, hair, body shape, size, pose and skin, and the same hands holding the same weapon in the same place. Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.

anim_notes.skill: The character's face stays clearly visible and lit with both eyes showing, not covered or darkened by the effect, flames or smoke. Only the character and its effect on an empty background: no walls, arches, doorways, portals, pillars or floor behind it
